messages.subject_clean: Sampling from regression data on the basis of smallest absolute residuals
messages.body_plain:
Hi Everyone,
   
  I am an R novice. i want to pick from the 30 regression fitted residuals data those 20 observation that has smallest absolute residuals and run OLS on the selected 20 data and got residuals for all 30 observations from the fitted model based on those 20 observations and want to select again 20 observations that has smallest  residuals..... and so on. i have used these codes
  ...........................
  a<- rank(abs(resid))
  which(a %in% c(1:20))
  sub<- which(a %in% c(1:20))
  lm(formula.original, data = original.data, subset = sub)
  ..................................................
  How  to do it repeatedly?  may be i need a loop for this if i am right, that select 20 out of 30 observation that has smallest absolute residuals and run OLS on it?
   
  Thanking in anticipation
  Dost

messages.subject: [R-sig-Epi] AIC values from Icens function
messages.body_plain:
Hi,
I am using the Icens function in the Epi package and was wondering if anyone
knows if the deviance values for the result (Icens.obj$cov$deviance or
Icens.obj$rates$deviance) are reliable.  I'd like to use AIC for model
building, but I don't know if the method of iteratively fitting results in
accurate AIC values.  Any ideas?
Thanks,
Summer
